result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is a clear text overlap in the “Popular right now” restaurant metadata and a minor clipped carousel/category edge.

issues.description: Under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar”, the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine metadata appear collided/garbled, showing text like “25–€0delivery” instead of separated “25–30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen”.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal spacing, place metadata on separate lines, or constrain each metadata item with ellipsis so time, fee, and tags never overlap.

issues.description: The horizontal category filter row shows the next chip partially cut off at the right edge with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade/scroll indicator or adjust padding so partially visible items look intentionally scrollable rather than clipped.
